manifest.name: Field Reference Example
manifest.description: A small demonstration pack exercising every field the pack format supports -- rooms, filler, variants, groups, custom reset events, and template vars. Ships with the repo as a safe default and as the source for documentation screenshots.

arrival.name: Arrival
arrival.read: A ring of pale light traces the edge of a perfectly round chamber, tinted {{cellColor}} by the tesseract you've entered through. A single door stands opposite the one you came through.
arrival.detail: The light comes from nowhere in particular -- the walls themselves seem to glow faintly.
arrival.gm: This is the demo pack's start room. {{wardenName}} is referenced here so you can see a pack-defined template var resolve alongside the built-in {{cellColor}}.
arrival.orientation: Every door in this pack is a plain rectangle unless a room says otherwise -- orientation text is where you'd describe anything stranger.

features.name: Engraved plaque
features.detail: "Here begins the Field Reference. Ask nothing of it; it answers nothing back."

twin-vault-a.name: Twin Vault
twin-vault-a.read: Two identical vault doors face each other across a narrow room lined in dull metal panels.
twin-vault-a.detail: Faint scratches on the floor suggest something heavy is dragged between the doors periodically.
twin-vault-a.gm: includeGroup pairs this room with twin-vault-b so both always share a tesseract. maxInstances 2 lets this room repeat once via filler.reusePool -- open the second copy to see the (II) label and the variant text below.

variants.text: This copy's vault door is sealed shut, welded at the seams.
This copy's vault door hangs open on one hinge.

onKey.read: With the tesseract's key in hand, both vault doors ease open on their own.
onKey.gm: Key-gated content: this only shows once the party holds this cell's key.

features.name: Dented strongbox
features.detail: A handful of coin and a folded map.

features.name: Release lever
features.detail: Opens both vault doors at once.

creatures.name: Patchwork sentry
creatures.notes: Wakes if the strongbox is touched.

rest.effect: The sentry stirs if anyone tries to rest here.

twin-vault-b.name: Twin Vault (other side)
twin-vault-b.read: The far half of the twin vault: a mirror of the room across from it, down to the scuffed floor panels.
twin-vault-b.gm: Second member of the twin-vaults includeGroup -- the generator guarantees this room and twin-vault-a always land in the same tesseract.

features.name: Pressure plate
features.detail: Triggers a loud alarm bell, nothing worse.

features.name: Spare key, on a hook
features.detail: A plain, unremarkable key. To what, nobody's said.

rest.effect: Safe only once the alarm bell has been silenced.

watch-post-alpha.name: Watch Post Alpha
watch-post-alpha.read: A narrow gantry clings to the inside of a curved wall, gravity pulling sideways toward the surface underfoot.
watch-post-alpha.gm: excludeGroup pairs this with watch-post-omega so the two can never share a tesseract -- useful for content that shouldn't be found twice in one visit.

watch-post-omega.name: Watch Post Omega
watch-post-omega.read: Identical in layout to its twin, but the gantry here runs the opposite direction.
watch-post-omega.gm: Second member of the watch-posts excludeGroup.

archive.name: Archive
archive.read: Shelves of loose pages spiral up into the dark, none of them quite reachable.
archive.gm: This room's custodian resets on "eclipse" -- a pack-defined event (see resetEvents at the top level), not one of the built-ins. It needs a GM menu trigger to actually fire.

features.name: Card index
features.detail: Cross-referenced, in a hand nobody recognizes.

creatures.name: Indexing construct
creatures.notes: Reshelves anything left on the floor.

threshold.name: Threshold
threshold.read: The far door here doesn't match the others -- plain wood, out of place, faint light under it.

drift-cell.name: Drift Cell
drift-cell.read: A bare cell, gravity settled in whatever direction it last landed. {{variant}}
drift-cell.gm: Filler template drawn by filler.templates. The {{variant}} marker in `read` is where each variant's text gets substituted in place, rather than appended.

variants.text: Dust has drifted into one corner, held there by nothing you can see.
A thin rime of frost coats the lower half of every wall.

quiet-cell.name: Quiet Cell
quiet-cell.read: A small, unremarkable room. Nothing about it asks for a second look.
quiet-cell.gm: Second filler template. This room's variant text has no {{variant}} marker, so the load code appends it as a trailing paragraph instead -- compare with drift-cell.

variants.text: A faint echo lingers a beat too long after every sound.
